notes: No chests or roboports on the orbital surface.
Connect the foundation patch to the platform hub.
The three input belts receive iron plates, carbon and ice from the asteroid-processing factory.

Two solar panels power the cell in Nauvis orbit (360 kW at 300% space solar; the cell averages about 156 kW). At a location with less space solar, add panels anywhere on the platform: its electric network is global.
Use four identical cells to reach 60 packs/min; total recipe demand is 24 iron plates, 12 carbon and 12 ice per minute.
